modification_test.method: replay x-kpsdk-ct/h/cd from live session against gql.twitch.tv/integrity with modified cd
modification_test.conclusion: x-kpsdk-cd proof-of-work contents are NOT validated server-side on this endpoint; any value yields a fresh encrypted token. The real gate is the x-kpsdk-ct session token + IP/TLS/device binding, not the PoW answers.

honest_caveats: This is one deployment (Twitch) and one endpoint (gql integrity). Other Kasada sites/endpoints may verify the VM output differently (the /tl flow issues ct from the VM's enciphered payload).
The ct token itself is server-issued; forging a NEW ct without the VM is the hard part. We reused a live ct.
The v4.local token is encrypted (STROBE-style); not decrypted.
